- `modem-fortios-54.out` keeps the captured fields used by the parser from page 397, including the last line. Subscriber identifiers are redacted and the MAC address is in the RFC 7042 documentation range. [Fortinet FortiOS 5.4 CLI Reference, page 397](https://docs.fortinet.com/document/fortigate/5.4.0/cli-reference) (the PDF is linked from that document library page)
- `modem-fortios-80-excerpt.out` is the Fortinet 8.0.0 example, which ends with an ellipsis. It is used to verify an incomplete capture. The guide uses a modem selector after the serial number. The serial-only spelling is documented by [Fortinet's FortiGate troubleshooting article](https://community.fortinet.com/fortigate-3/troubleshooting-tip-fortiextender-dataplan-cannot-be-displayed-in-fortigate-gui-229168). [FortiOS 8.0.0 Administration Guide](https://docs.fortinet.com/document/fortigate/8.0.0/administration-guide/78353/adding-a-fortiextender)
- Tests insert synthetic identifier canaries, remove lines or append a pager mark to the 5.4 excerpt. The refusal uses the FortiOS `Unknown action 0` response measured in the existing multi-VDOM tests, with a synthetic identifier appended.

The modem examples use `.out` so their dedicated parser tests keep them separate from the frozen historical classifier corpus.
